pilot.name: Pilot reel
pilot.terms: First order only. One 15-second reel from up to 8 supplied photos. 1 concept, 1 revision. 50% advance; preview within 48 hours of receiving the agreed brief and cleared assets. If you do not approve it after the revision, the advance is refunded.

monthly.name: Starter
monthly.scope: 4 × 15-second reels, up to 8 photos each; 1 revision each.

monthly.name: Growth
monthly.scope: Everything in Starter, plus 4 static posts; 1 revision each.

monthly.name: Pro
monthly.scope: Everything in Growth, expanded to 6 reels (one may be 30 seconds) and 8 static posts in total; 1 revision each. 48-hour turnaround from an agreed brief and cleared assets.

websites.name: Launch Page
websites.scope: 1 page, up to 6 sections. Mobile-friendly, with call / WhatsApp / enquiry form pathways and a map.

websites.name: Business Site
websites.scope: 3 to 5 pages: Home, About, Services, Gallery and Contact. Mobile-friendly, with an enquiry form.

websites.name: Showcase Site
websites.scope: Up to 7 main pages, or up to 10 listing / project / profile pages. The selected structure is agreed in writing.

care.name: Website Care Plan
care.scope: Per month. Hosting handled, backups and 1 small edit a month.

addons.name: Cafe menu page
addons.scope: Menu, timings, map and WhatsApp. No ordering.

addons.name: Logo + starter identity
addons.scope: A logo and starter visual identity; scope agreed in writing.
